offering_description.value: Provides management, technology and analytics consulting, plus cybersecurity and engineering services, mainly to US government agencies. Delivers it through teams of consultants and technologists on contracts, often built on its own software and data platforms.

primary_products.value: analytics platforms; cybersecurity tools; data software

primary_services.value: management consulting; technology consulting; cybersecurity services; data analytics; engineering services

customer_segment.value: B2G: US defense, intelligence and civilian federal agencies; B2B: commercial clients in energy and health, a smaller share

end_markets.value: defense; intelligence; civilian government; health; energy

revenue_model.value: project or contract: government contracts for consulting and technology work; service fees: managed services and support for agency programs; licensing or royalties: software licenses for its proprietary platforms
revenue_model.category: project or contract; service fees; licensing or royalties
